description: Geometry optimization (cell-relax for full cell, relax for ions only)

ecutwfc.rule: well converged, same as SCF，100 for lcao, 50 for pw

relax_method.note: CG is robust default. BFGS for large systems near minimum.

fixed_axes.rule: None for full relaxation, or 'a'/'b'/'c'/'ab'/'ac'/'bc'/'abc' to constrain

smearing_method.rule: gauss for metals, fixed for insulators

kpt.rule: Same as SCF, well-converged MP grid

workflow_notes: Use cell-relax for full cell optimization
May need multiple runs for cell-relax
Use STRU_READIN_ADJUST.cif or OUT.suffix/STRU_ION_D for continuation
